in_sanskrit.name: Sontosh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Wisdom
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sontosh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Sontosh is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Santosh’, which means contentment, satisfaction and happiness. The name is believed to bestow the blessings of Lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe and the deity of happiness and prosperity.
